Image 2 is much too realistic; discard its realistic rendering, textures, anatomy proportions and complexity. STRICT authentic low-resolution pixel art as if drawn on a 96x96 pixel grid and enlarged with nearest-neighbor: visible square pixels, hard stepped pixel contours, flat limited-color pixel clusters, 2-3 shading tones per surface. Keep iron mine fantasy theme, steel grey armor, small brass accents and a few cyan magnetic pixels. One full-body monster, 3/4 facing left, centered square with 10% transparent margins around every edge, all appendages visible. Genuine transparent background, no environment, no ground rectangle, no label, no text, no UI.
